D/ FL IVL CONSTANTIVS NOB C ; R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS

A copper alloy Roman Nummus of CONSTANTIUS II (330-348 AD ). Obverse legend: FL IVL CONSTANTIVS NOB C (laureate, cuirassed bust right). Reverse legend: GLORIA EXERCITVS (two soldiers holding a spears and leaning on shields; between them, two standards,. Diameter 15.8mm, Weight 1.74gms
